Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an '''''Acclamator''-class assault ship''' was used to transport [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] during a [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|battle]] there.
